headline: On last trading day, Sensex crashed 1,000 points as banking and IT stocks led a major market sell-off

marketStatus.message: Market is closed for trading today due to an NSE holiday. It will reopen on Thursday, 22 October.

why: Banking and IT stocks led the losses during the previous trading session on Monday
Investors lost approximately Rs 5 lakh crore as major indices tanked significantly
The Sensex plunged over 900 points, causing the Nifty50 to drop below the 22,900 level
Broad-based selling pressure across sectors contributed to the sharp market crash
whatHappening: Indian stock markets are closed today, October 20, 2026, for the Dussehra holiday
Reports indicate hackers claim to have accessed confidential data of 3.75 lakh SBI accounts
Akash Ambani emphasized Jio's identity as a technology company ahead of its planned IPO
US Senator Marco Rubio met with Jaishankar in Mumbai to discuss energy as a transformative alternative
summary: The Indian stock market is closed today for Dussehra after a volatile Monday session where the Sensex crashed nearly 1,000 points. Investors lost Rs 5 lakh crore as banking and IT stocks faced heavy selling pressure, dragging the Nifty below 22,900. Corporate news remains active with reports of a data breach at SBI and Jio's technology-focused IPO positioning.
